name: @trace/desktop
//productName: What `app.getName()` returns, which is what `app.getPath('userData')` is built from. Without it the scoped package name wins and a Trace install keeps its vault and window state in %APPDATA%/@trace/desktop — a nested folder named after an npm scope, in the one directory a user might actually go looking. electron-builder.yml sets the same value for the installer and the executable; this one is for the running app.
description: Trace — the desktop Agents Window. Chat is the frame; the work panel is the viewport.
author: Origin AI

scripts.package: pnpm -w run build && electron-vite build && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.package:dir: pnpm -w run build && electron-vite build && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs && electron-builder --dir
